solutions.title: Your journey to high-performance solutions starts here.

items.title: SAP Transportation Management (TM)
items.desc: Complete solutions focused on efficient transportation planning and execution. Our approach optimizes routes, reduces logistics costs and increases operational visibility — combining technical expertise with strategic vision to turn transportation into a competitive edge.

items.title: SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L)
items.desc: Smart integration between shippers, carriers and logistics partners. Through a collaborative platform, we ensure real-time visibility, process automation and stronger connectivity across the entire logistics network.

items.title: SAP Implementation & Support
items.desc: We cover every stage of the SAP journey: from case study, through process design, to implementation. Our methodology combines agility, governance and technical excellence — and continuous post go-live support ensures stability and evolution.

items.title: SAP Resource Allocation
items.desc: We optimize your company's operational capacity by acting directly on planning and the strategic distribution of teams and assets, ensuring the right resources are available at the right time.

rochalog.title: Rochalog: SAP TM delivered in 8 months with a 3-consultant squad.
rochalog.summary: In strategic partnership with IBM, we designed and implemented the SAP TM solution for Rochalog, optimizing the sale of transportation services and the contracting of road freight — from blueprint to Go-Live and continuous evolution.
differentials: Tailored solution aligned with the SAP standard — no unnecessary customizations.

Continuous improvement post Go-Live — immediate operational gains.

faq.title: Common questions about how we work.

items.q: How does the lean squad model work?
items.a: We assemble teams of 2 to 4 senior consultants per project, sized to the real scope — no junior consultants in training or redundant roles. This lowers cost and speeds up decisions without compromising quality.

items.q: How long does a SAP TM or BN4L project take?
items.a: It varies with scope, but full implementation projects typically run 6 to 10 months, from blueprint to Go-Live. Support and continuous evolution are contracted per cycle or on demand.

items.q: Do you work with companies that already have SAP running?
items.a: Yes. Beyond greenfield implementations, we handle roll-outs, upgrades, sustaining and evolution of existing SAP environments, with a focus on logistics and transportation.

items.q: How does the partnership with IBM work?
items.a: We act as a specialized squad within IBM-led projects, complementing delivery with deep technical expertise in SAP TM and BN4L — as in the Rochalog case.

items.q: Can we hire just consultant allocation?
items.a: Yes. Besides closed-scope projects, we offer senior SAP consultants on demand, in flexible specialized body-shop models.
